name: acosh
comment: Sig: y = acosh(x). Element-wise inverse-trig (libm-backed). ARRAY promotion (fixed 2026-06-05): any element <1 promotes the WHOLE array to complex — acosh([0.5 2])=[0+1.0472i 1.31696+0i] (previously the <1 element became real NaN); acosh(-2)=1.31696+pi*i. std::acosh's complex branch matches MATLAB. Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09 — fingerprint covers domain edges + a few interior points. verified bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-12 covers libm vs Intel-SVML differences).
